method: Cold grade per rubric_worked_example_RSI.md (mounted). axis_rationales.v: 0.92 — dilemma structure (procreative duty or axiology) genuinely exhausts the objector's routes given the concession framing; disanalogy, overgeneration, unheld/unholdable, Parfit each logically clean. Not higher: 'formulas protect persons, not the headcount of a type' is an argued interpretive step, not a derivation.
axis_rationales.s: 0.88 — load-bearing spine (conceivability of the last generation; overgeneration parity; success-condition reading; Parfit's distinction) is secure. The contested premises (means-reversal of duty-driven procreation; Kantian scope over merely possible agents) are deployed with correct modality — as pressure and as routing, not as load — so the stated verdict does not rest on winning them.
axis_rationales.c: c = 0.89 (Completeness) — both horns of the dilemma, the conception form, the legislation/publicity variant, and the will-prong routing are covered inside the T5 band, with the residue routed to a named terminus. Not higher: two load-bearing moves — "unheld is not unholdable" and formulas-protect-persons-not-the-headcount-of-a-type — ship at single-sentence compression, their development omitted rather than out-of-scope: a coverage cost at the margin. [superseded per Exchange 148, 2026-07-10; original preserved in git history]
axis_rationales.r: 0.88 — preempts the procreative-duty retreat, the axiological retreat, the perfectionist insistence, the publicity variant, and the morality's-precondition variant; residue routed to a NAMED terminus (asymmetry / population-ethics cluster). Left standing: a Korsgaardian regress on valuing the conditions of agency pressed harder than the routing treats it.
